name: cartelera
description: Cartelera is an AI video studio. Tell it your idea and it plans the script, the scene photos, the music and the edit, then waits for your approval before animating anything.

interface.longDescription:
Cartelera turns an idea into a finished video: animate a photo or a painting, make a commercial for your business, a short series, a house tour or a music video with an original song.

What you can do from ChatGPT:
- Start a project from a short description (style, length, vertical or horizontal).
- Follow the plan step by step: Cartelera prepares the script, the scene photos and the music, and you can change any scene or pick a different photo.
- Nothing is animated until you approve it: Cartelera asks first, with a one-time code, and never goes past the daily limit you chose when you connected.
- Review the ORIGINAL photos for every scene directly in the private in-chat Cartelera gallery, not regenerated images.
- Play existing music and finished videos from ChatGPT; renew links when they expire.
- Download the finished MP4 when it is ready.

Who it is for: families who want to bring old photos to life, small businesses that need short ads, and creators who want music videos and series in Spanish or English.

Limitations: animating scenes requires a Cartelera account; long videos take a few minutes per scene; Cartelera does not make adult, violent or impersonation content.
capabilities: Create a video project from a short idea
Animate a photo or a painting
Write an original song and make its music video
Plan the script and the scene photos
Change a scene or choose a different photo
Ask for your approval before animating
See original scene photos in an in-chat gallery
Listen to existing soundtrack and play delivered videos inside ChatGPT
defaultPrompt: Animate my grandparents' wedding photo into a short video with a love song
Make a 30-second vertical ad for my taco shop
Create a music video for a corrido about my hometown

positive.prompt: What can Cartelera do for me?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains the kinds of videos Cartelera makes, that planning is free and that animating scenes needs an approved quote.

positive.description: Start a new video project from an idea
positive.prompt: Make a 15-second vertical video of a cat surfing at sunset, no music
positive.expected_behavior: A new project is created; ChatGPT shows its title, the planned scenes and a link to open it in the Cartelera studio, without spending tokens.
ChatGPT lists the user's projects with their title, stage and last update.

positive.prompt: Show the scenes of my latest project and make scene 2 happen at night
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows the scenes, updates the description of scene 2 to a night setting and confirms the change.

positive.description: Quote the animation cost before spending
positive.prompt: How much would it cost to animate my latest project?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows the exact cost in tokens and the user's balance, and says that nothing is spent until the user approves.

positive.description: Show original scene photos in ChatGPT
positive.prompt: In Cartelera, show original photos for all scenes of my latest project, without generating new images
positive.expected_behavior: Show original scene photos in the integrated gallery. No images invented or regenerated; read only.

positive.description: Listen to music from a project in ChatGPT
positive.prompt: Play the existing soundtrack from my latest Cartelera project and renew the links if they expire
positive.expected_behavior: Show the project's music player and renewable download links without generating media or spending tokens.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Plain writing request with no video
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the sea
Translate 'good morning, how are you?' into French
